title: Automated Video Repurposing Poster

brand.name: Clippr
brand.tagline: Turn long videos into viral shorts

copy.headline: Repurpose videos in seconds
copy.support: AI cuts your long-form videos into engaging viral clips instantly.

concept: A sleek vector illustration of a video play button transforming into multiple rising vertical shorts, conveying fast and automated content repurposing.

design_system.style: Modern flat vector with rich gradients, subtle inner glows, and layered depth
design_system.lighting: Top-left studio lighting with a vibrant purple and blue glow behind the central icon

composition.hero: A central glowing horizontal video play button transitioning smoothly into three vertical smartphone outlines floating upward, styled with bright gradients of indigo and cyan, smooth rounded corners, and soft drop shadows.
props: Abstract speed lines trailing upward behind the phones
Small circular dots floating near the edges
composition.background: Deep navy vertical gradient from dark blue 0f172a to slate 1e293b with a faint radial glow in the center and subtle diagonal grid lines.
decor: Large translucent rounded rectangle in the background
Faint outlined circle near the top edge
